NEW: 🟠 Bitcoin Core discloses a bug that lets one peer freeze a node for more than 12 seconds per malicious message. CVE-2026-117348 abuses the "orphanage": an attacker repeats one orphan transaction with thousands of missing parents, forcing the same costly check thousands of times. Project Loupe, an AI scanner built at Block's Spiral, found it in July. Versions 29.0 to 31.2 are affected. Fixes ship in 30.5, 31.3 and 32.1, and the 29.x branch gets no patch. If you run a node, update. Source: https://x.com/BitcoinNewsCom/status/2125204945230090465
